name: Gerhardt von Waldstein
original_name: ゲルハルト･フォン･バルシュタイン
source:
Special guest.
The main character of Dengeki Bunko's "Vamp!" A vampire who speaks many different languages. He lives on an island in Germany where he holds the title of viscount.
